title: Overprint
description: Three huge numerals in process red, blue and yellow race across paper-white stock at their own speeds, each a translucent ink laid over the others. Where they cross the inks multiply like a real press run: red over yellow goes vermilion, blue over yellow goes green, all three go nearly black. Grab one and throw it to set its pace; the faster it runs, the longer it leans and drags its ink.
intent: After Max Huber's Monza race posters (Gran Premio dell'Autodromo 1948, 500 Miglia di Monza 1957), where transparent primary inks overprint so numbers and speed bands mix into new colours as they cross. https://a-g-i.org/design/500-miglia-di-monza
